name: A unified taxonomy of explanation methods for NLP
source: Explainable NLP in the Era of Large Language Models: A Unified Taxonomy, Evaluation Frameworks, and Decision Guidance (Mohammadi and Shahedi, Utrecht University; under review at the Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research)

values.description: Query the model with modified inputs (occlusion, erasure, sampling-based feature removal, counterfactual search) and read importance off the resulting output changes
Backpropagate signals from the output through the model's weights, as in vanilla gradients, Integrated Gradients, or Layer-wise Relevance Propagation
Fit an interpretable proxy model, either locally around one prediction (as in LIME) or globally via distillation
Read internal states such as attention weights, hidden representations, probe outputs, or learned dictionary features without modifying the model
Ablate or patch model components and measure the behavioral consequences, as in head pruning, layer ablation, and activation patching
Elicit an explanation from the model itself in natural language, as in chain-of-thought prompting and self-explanation

Build the explanation into the model itself, so that it is a by-product of the forward computation, as in select-then-predict rationale architectures, concept bottleneck models, and weight-sparse transformers
